# Fused Productions - Blank Vendor Subcontractor Agreement & SLA Template

## SUBCONTRACTOR OPERATIONAL STANDARDS
1. **Compliance & Insurance:** All subcontractors must provide verified W-9 forms and a Certificate of Insurance (COI) naming Fused Productions as an additional insured[cite: 1].
2. **Schedule Adherence:** Subcontractors must comply strictly with centralized dispatch run-times, load-in windows, and sound checks[cite: 1].
3. **Quality & Conduct:** Strict adherence to professional dress codes, equipment quality thresholds, and zero-tolerance policies for unscheduled delays.
